cwd.description: Working directory at the time of the action.

error_summary.description: Short error description if the action failed. Redacted and truncated to 2 KB.

evidence_feedback.description: Map of evidence ids from the guard receipt to memory validation outcomes.

files.description: File paths to fingerprint (size + mtime + content hash).

input.description: Tool input. Hashed and never stored raw; redacted metadata is only stored when retain_details is true.

output.description: Tool output. Same redaction and storage policy as input.

override_reason.description: Reason for recording a succeeded outcome against a Guard receipt that blocked for a reason other than an exact-repeated failure. Not needed for acknowledged exact-failure retries.

retain_details.description: If true, redacted input and output payloads are stored alongside hashes. Defaults to false.

session_id.description: Session identifier for grouping related guard events.

tool.description: Tool or command family that completed, e.g. Bash, npm test, Edit, deploy.
